ideas.pitch: An autonomous local git hooks daemon that uses offline small language models to inspect staged code changes for security anti-patterns before commits hit upstream FOSS repositories.
ideas.title: RepoDoctor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at open-source contributors during a Hacktoberfest event; judges appreciate utility tools that solve real-world maintainer bottlenecks.

ideas.pitch: A localized GitHub action runner simulation that automatically categorizes, labels, and generates first-pass review summaries for incoming pull requests in student-led repositories.
ideas.title: PR-Triage-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the core ethos of Hacktoberfest (handling PR volume) with an autonomous agentic approach proven to win agent hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight interactive visualization tool that maps out FOSS dependency networks and highlights stale or unmaintained packages directly inside your local workspace.
ideas.title: CommitTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses open-source software supply chain visibility, a high-priority theme for maintainers and FOSS organizers.

ideas.pitch: A local CLI tool that ingests an open GitHub issue URL, crawls the codebase using AST parsing, and generates a minimal contextual patch file using locally run open-source models.
ideas.title: IssueToPatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines deep developer tooling with hard engineering (AST parsing and local model execution) suited for a 12-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An automated documentation updater that monitors local code refactors and injects updated architectural flow diagrams and API signatures directly into your project's markdown files.
ideas.title: ReadMeSync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the eternal FOSS problem of outdated documentation with zero manual overhead, appealing directly to hackathon judges looking for immediate utility.
